attestation expiry blocks unqualified edge claim

source high-watermark rollback blocks capability lease
failed sink permission revision probe blocks authority guarantee
retention shorter than disconnect horizon is degraded
poll-only source does not claim event-driven edge recovery
revoked signing key prevents capability registration

limitations: In-memory capability-lease model; no production signature verifier, key registry, live source probe or scheduler is exercised.
Signature, issuer, key and conformance status are trusted test booleans, not cryptographic evidence.
Production adapters must persist and independently verify capability attestations, probes and connector/profile changes.
